name: Actions
description: Agent-proposed action cards: renew domain, rotate key, investigate spend, restart service, ack incident

agentPrompts.label: Review the action queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-devops` skill in this folder, then list the action cards awaiting a decision, each with its type, reason, evidence, and proposed plan, so I can decide what to approve.

agentPrompts.label: Approve, request changes, or block an action
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-devops` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then write my verdict (approve, request changes, or block) and note onto the action card I name. Never mark a card done yourself — that only happens after the real renewal/rotation/restart is performed outside the app and reported back.

agentPrompts.label: Mark an approved action done
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-devops` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then, only after I confirm the real-world renewal/rotation/restart already happened, mark the named action card done with a note describing what was done, and append the matching event.
